parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Phenolphthalein is an indicator and is represented by the formula HIn. Phenolphthalein, HIn, is a weak acid.

$$\text{HIn} \rightleftharpoons \text{H}^{+} + \text{In}^{-}$$

The $K_{\text{a}}$ value for phenolphthalein is $5.0 \times 10^{-10} \text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ at $298 \text{ K}$. This indicator changes colour at a pH of approximately 8.8.

Calculate the ratio $\frac{[\text{In}^{-}]}{[\text{HIn}]}$ at pH 8.8.
